text: Before electric light, nights were long and dark. People went to bed a couple of hours after sunset… and slept until around midnight. This is a first sleep.

text: Then they woke up, all by themselves, for an hour or so. And then they slept again until morning. This is a second sleep.

text: Operator Nina asks: "So what did they do at midnight?" Nina… they prayed, talked, checked the fire… and some visited the neighbors.
